description: This file defines a React component 'ImportModal' for handling import functionality in a web application, including state management, file processing, and UI rendering.

methods.name: reducer
methods.description: Handles state updates for import modal, managing files, import tags, and resetting state.

methods.name: importFromPayloads
methods.description: Imports data from transfer payloads, updating file statuses and handling success/error states.

methods.name: parseAndImport
methods.description: Processes all files, extracts payloads, and creates an import tag summarizing imported notes.

methods.name: closeDialog
methods.description: Closes the import modal and optionally sets the selected tag in the navigation controller.
